cases.note: Canonical form, 64 zero bytes.

cases.note: Canonical form, wrong signature.

cases.note: '=' padding on the right 64 bytes.

cases.name: gidgp-verify-signature-std-alphabet
cases.note: The standard alphabet, same 64 bytes.

cases.note: A non-zero unused bit in the last character; lenient decoders read the same 64 bytes.

cases.name: gidgp-verify-signature-line-feed-inside
cases.note: A JSON-escaped line feed inside the decoded value.
